title: Night-Blooming Flower
central_conflict: the celebrated flower remained closed when the evening festival began
decisive_choice: an old gardener's notebook explained that it opened in cool darkness
resolution: moved the flower outside and watched it open beneath the first stars
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the celebrated flower remained closed when the evening festival began before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they carried it into a bright tent, but the petals closed even tighter; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized an old gardener's notebook explained that it opened in cool darkness; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they moved the flower outside and watched it open beneath the first stars, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: False Alarm at the Bridge

resolution: secured the vine and tested the warning system before reopening the crossing

title: The Reversed Trail Map
central_conflict: the rescue map led volunteers away from the shelter
decisive_choice: the compass rose had been printed backward on the replacement sheet
resolution: corrected the orientation and marked the verified route to the shelter
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the rescue map led volunteers away from the shelter before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they followed the marked turns twice, but both paths ended at the same fence; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the compass rose had been printed backward on the replacement sheet; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they corrected the orientation and marked the verified route to the shelter, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
